title: fix(service-messaging): a GET or HEAD delivery through the HTTP outbox sends no body and is signed over what it sends
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCpddLFmKzR39wJWZpkRMCi)_
Fixes #33895
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：消息 HTTP 发件箱投递 GET/HEAD 请求时不再带请求体，签名改为对实际发出的内容（空串）计算；SQL 与内存两种发件箱在入队时都按方法签名。
- 为什么改：持久化 http 节点写 `method: 'GET'` 时，发件箱总是发送 `'{}'`，`fetch` 拒绝带请求体的 GET，投递一直重试直到死亡。18.5.0 说明里推荐的 `method: 'GET'` 写法在有发件箱时根本不可用。
- 风险与回滚：POST 等其他方法行为不变；导出类型 `FetchImpl` 的 `init.body` 变为可选，自定义 fetchImpl 的类型可能需要接受 `undefined`。修复前已入队的 GET/HEAD 行仍带 `'{}'` 的旧签名。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/services/service-messaging/src/http-sender.ts`（`deliveryBody` 与 `sendOnce` 的无请求体分支）、`sql-http-outbox.ts` 第 143 行附近的入队签名、新测试 `http-sender-bodyless-33895.test.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run src/http-sender-bodyless-33895.test.ts`，预期 9 个用例全部通过（含真实本地接收端的 GET/HEAD 投递与 sqlite 发件箱签名）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `http-sender.ts`: `deliveryBody(payload, method?)` answers `''` for GET and HEAD (new helper `isBodylessMethod`). `sendOnce` sends a GET or HEAD with no `body` key and without the default `Content-Type: application/json`. Every other method sends exactly what it sent before.
- `sql-http-outbox.ts` and `memory-http-outbox.ts`: the enqueue-time signature is computed over `deliveryBody(input.payload, input.method)`, so a GET or HEAD is signed over the empty string, the bytes it sends. This is the published scheme's signature for a request with no body, and the one the `http` node's inline call already sends.
- The exported `FetchImpl` type: `init.body` is optional. Seven test fetch recorders (four in service-messaging, three in plugin-webhooks) store `init.body ?? ''`, the bytes on the wire, so their `body: string` records and every assertion over them stay as they were.
- `service-automation/src/builtin/http-nodes.ts`: comment only. The two comments that said the outbox sends and signs `'{}'` for a node with no body now name the GET/HEAD exception.
- Patch changeset for `@objectstack/service-messaging`. It names the `FetchImpl` type change and that rows enqueued as GET/HEAD with a signing secret before this fix still carry a signature over `'{}'`.

The released 18.5.0 note that names `method: 'GET'` as the way to keep the old verb on a durable `http` node now reads true with an outbox wired too. The CHANGELOG is release-owned and is not edited here.

## Tests

`http-sender-bodyless-33895.test.ts` (new, 9 cases):
- GET, HEAD and lowercase `get` through `MemoryHttpOutbox` and `HttpDispatcher` to a recording fetch: no `body` key, no `Content-Type`, signature equal to `signHttpBody('', secret)` and verified by `verifyHttpSignature`, row `success` after one attempt.
- GET and HEAD to a real `node:http` receiver on 127.0.0.1 through the real global `fetch`: delivered once, received body `''`, and the signature verifies over what arrived.
- `SqlHttpOutbox` on sqlite, GET and HEAD: the stored signature covers the empty body, fetch gets no body, and the row succeeds.
- CONTROL: a POST still sends `'{}'` with `Content-Type: application/json`, signed over `'{}'`.
- Unit pins on `deliveryBody` for each method.

## Acceptance notes

1. The area widened the file surface (claim amendment 6897279605). Its "one-word recorder type fix" was spelled `body: string` to `body?: string` on the recorder's element type. Read against the files, that spelling cascades into about 25 `createHmac(...).update(calls[0].body)` and `JSON.parse(calls[0].body)` sites, which would then type-error on `string | undefined`. So each recorder's push site records `init.body ?? ''` instead, one token per file. These recorders only see POST deliveries, and `''` is the zero bytes a bodyless request carries.
2. If a durable `http` node has an authored `body` and `method: 'GET'`, the outbox now drops the body, following the card's ruling that a GET or HEAD outbox delivery carries no body. The inline arm still sends that body and `fetch` throws loudly. The two arms differ on this edge, and this card does not change that.
3. Rows at rest are not rewritten: rows already enqueued as signed GET/HEAD keep their `'{}'` signature (the secret is not stored), so a verifying receiver refuses them. They never delivered before this fix either. The changeset says so and tells the operator to re-run the flow.

## Verification

Each reading names the head it was taken on. The GET ablation ran on `439f01b0`, whose `http-sender.ts` is byte-identical to this head (the test file then had 7 cases, before the SQL pins). The SQL ablation ran on `9c3d63d7`, whose `sql-http-outbox.ts` and test file are byte-identical to this head.

<details><summary>Tests and typecheck (os-verify-lock, VERDICT command-exit 0)</summary>

- On `9c3d63d7`, after building the closure: `@objectstack/service-messaging` test passed, Test Files 72 passed (72), Tests 981 passed (981), and typecheck exit 0. `@objectstack/plugin-webhooks` test passed, Test Files 25 passed (25), Tests 307 passed (307), and typecheck exit 0.
- On `4ed33935` (after merging origin/main, which touched `service-automation/src/plugin.ts`): `@objectstack/service-automation` test passed, Test Files 282 passed (282), Tests 4001 passed (4001), and typecheck exit 0.
- `pnpm lint` exit 0 (run on `3cfa0d08`, before the two merges of main, which touched none of these files).
</details>

<details><summary>Ablations</summary>

- GET pin. The fix was committed first. `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the anchor `...(bodyless ? {} : { body }),` with `body,`: anchor x1 to x0, blob c7f8fa4f to 3b405aca. Result: Tests 5 failed, 2 passed (7). The failures include `expected true to be false` (a body key is present). On the real receiver, the row error was `expected 'Request with GET/HEAD method cannot h...' to be undefined`. The CONTROL POST stayed green. After restore, the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- SQL signing pin. `deliveryBody(input.payload, input.method)` was replaced with `deliveryBody(input.payload)` in `sql-http-outbox.ts`: anchor x1 to x0, blob b1ca5375 to a17952df. Result: Tests 2 failed, 7 passed (9). The failures are the GET and HEAD on sqlite cases, where the signature was the one over `'{}'` (`sha256=e54138d3...`, expected `sha256=2160e461...`). After restore, the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
</details>

<details><summary>Gate families</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 71 families. Each was run with its exit code recorded. `--ran` printed: 71 derived, 69 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- NOT MEASURED, reason: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n` both exited 3 with PREREQUISITE NOT MET. They need a whole-repo build, and the CLI build, that this worktree did not do. CI runs both.
- `git merge-tree --write-tree` of HEAD against origin/main: exit 0.
</details>
